CustomField.description: Salesforce ContentDocument ID of the unsigned source file. Stored as Text(18) because Salesforce does not support custom Lookup fields targeting ContentDocument. Integrity enforced by Apex — do not write directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: ContentDocument ID of the unsigned file. Salesforce platform does not allow a custom Lookup to ContentDocument, so this is stored as text. All writes go through SwiftSign Apex.
CustomField.label: Content Document Id
